'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male professor found talking about [[Chisa]] with another professor, along with students from Department of Voidmatters, during the day near by {{Rubi|Solis Lens Array|Lahai-Roi Resonance Nexus}}.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Lehton:''' Should we consider moving her up a grade?
:'''Pyak:''' But she just got back. She's still learning the ropes.

==Dialogue==
:'''Lehton:''' She was gone for ''years'', and now she's not just keeping up, she's even ahead. Should we consider moving her up a grade?
:'''Pyak:''' Maybe... but she just got back. She's still learning the ropes. Jumping her ahead now might just make it worse.
:'''Anders:''' Technically, she's a year below us, so she's our junior, right?
:'''Heller:''' But she enrolled years before we did... Calling her our "junior" just feels wrong...
:'''Haruka:''' Why overthink it? Just call her Chisa. Who cares about seniority?
:'''Haruka:''' Spend that energy helping her catch up in Engineering!
{{Dialogue End}}
